prompt_policy: Contact only when right hand/fingers/palm visibly touches or holds the object; near/ambiguous is false.

decisions.reason: The person's right hand is reaching/hovering at a visible distance from the scanner and not touching it.
The person's right hand is reaching toward the scanner but remains visibly separated with a clear gap and no touch or grasp.
Right hand is reaching toward the scanner but there is a visible gap and no clear physical touch.
The person's right hand is reaching toward the scanner but a visible gap remains; no clear fingertip or palm contact is shown.
Right hand is very close to the scanner but no clear visible fingertip or palm contact; possible gap/ambiguous.
The person's right hand/fingers visibly overlap and appear to grasp the upper pink scanner with no clear gap.
The person's right fingertips visibly overlap and touch the top/side of the pink scanner with no clear gap.
